reason: Named independent lab and a batch report I can actually open is the thing I usually can't find, and the pre-counted sachet fits my forgetting-vitamins-on-the-counter problem. At $24.99 for one box I'll try it, but only one.
objection: Brand new with zero reviews, made in China, and I want to see that the batch report is real and the lab is a real lab before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the sample batch report and finding it is vague, missing the batch number, or from a lab I can't verify would make me pass.
